name: Workbench Tabs
description: Display Drupal's local task tabs and status messages in a consistent location on all pages.
project_description: Workbench Tabs relocates Drupal's local task tabs (Edit / View / Revisions / Delete) and status messages out of the theme's page regions and into a fixed bar rendered at the top of every page via hook_page_top(). This means custom front-end themes do not need to place or style these administrative elements themselves, long status messages no longer break the page layout, and the tabs an editor relies on stay in one predictable location regardless of which theme renders the current page. Despite the 'Workbench' package name it is standalone — it does not depend on the Workbench module or on the core Toolbar module. The treatment is gated by the 'use workbench_tabs' permission (granted to authenticated users on install); users without it see status messages in their theme's normal location. By default the bar is applied only on non-admin-theme pages; a settings option can enable it everywhere. When active, it also hides the core local_tasks_block to avoid duplicate tabs.
